title: Elevated API timeouts on /v1/events
description: A backend deployment on 2026-08-28 caused intermittent timeouts for batch event submissions over 500 events. Resolved 2026-08-29; recommend batching under 500 events as a workaround for older clients.

title: Auth token expiry misconfiguration
description: Some accounts are seeing auth errors due to a token expiry misconfiguration being rolled out gradually. Engineering is aware and deploying a fix; no customer action required.
